objects.description: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has used [CaddyWiper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0693), [SDelete](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0195), and the [BlackEnergy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0089) KillDisk component to overwrite files on victim systems. (Citation: US-CERT Ukraine Feb 2016)(Citation: ESET Telebots June 2017)(Citation: Mandiant-Sandworm-Ukraine-2022) Additionally, [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has used the JUNKMAIL tool to overwrite files with null bytes.(Citation: mandiant_apt44_unearthing_sandworm)
